The shop sells delicious snails
Apr 2024 • Family
The restaurant's snails are not gritty, the sauces are delicious, the best is the butter sauce. The accompanying bread is always hot and crispy. Suggesting you some typical snail dishes of the restaurant include: Grilled oysters with greasy cheese; snails stir-fried with garlic butter, crunchy, sweet and fragrant; Horse snail stir-fried with pepper; Thai steamed silk scallops; Steamed snails with lemongrass. The restaurant's strengths are snail dishes, stir-fried seafood with garlic, but grilled dishes are not very attractive. And if you like bland food, you should consider adding more because the restaurant's accompanying dipping sauce is sweet.
